generation_layer.interpretation: the cumulative rate (4.39 tok/s) is far below the recent-window rate (10.46 tok/s) and the window rate is RISING. That signature is a slow start that recovers, which is what VRAM pressure looks like: the first tens of seconds are spent paging the working set in, after which throughput climbs toward the machine's actual capability.

what_the_probe_required.demand: the integers 1..400, one per line, with no other output
what_the_probe_required.verdict_on_capacity: the machine reached ~10 tok/s in its best 3-second window but sustained only ~4.4 tok/s across the probe, so it is MARGINAL rather than dead: it needs roughly a 2x improvement in sustained rate, which is exactly what removing the paging pressure would supply

environment_at_gate_time.note: the model is ~5.05 GiB, so at 7672/8188 MiB used there is no headroom for the 8192-token KV cache and compute buffers

what_would_likely_make_the_same_frozen_g: closing GPU-consuming desktop applications so that roughly 6.5 GiB or more of the 8.19 GiB device is free before the model loads
or restarting the machine, which releases all accumulated VRAM

num_ctx, num_predict, temperature, the 120s timeout, the absence of a structured-output constraint
